text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Enterprise EG2000 was a British home computer released in 1985 after being designed as a powerful Z80-based system for gaming, programming, and education. It featured custom graphics and sound hardware that were advanced for its time, along with expandable memory and cartridge support. Although it faced strong competition from other 8-bit computers, the Enterprise developed a dedicated community and became known for its impressive technical capabilities.
